videos.title: 3ABN Today
videos.description: How do we tell the truth when it’s hard to hear? And what does compassion look like when we disagree? On this episode of 3ABN Today, Pastor Ryan and Anissa Johnson, along with Ian Vandervalk and Fotini Martinez, look at how Jesus treated people and ask whether truth and compassion are really in competition. From the way we listen to the words we choose, they explore what it means to speak the truth in love.

videos.title: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
videos.description: In this captivating episode of "A Wolf in Sheep's Clothing," we delve deep into the life of Davie Garcia, a young man lured into the world of Wicca through the captivating sounds of Heavy Metal music. With an exploration into the biblical connection between music and spiritual influence, Davie recounts his turbulent journey from the allure of the occult to finding solace and salvation in Christ. Join us as we uncover the profound impact of music, spirituality, and redemption in shaping Davie's life, offering a compelling testimony of transformation and faith.

videos.title: Tomorrow in 30 Minutes
videos.description: Pr Mike Browning explores the biblical concept of the Heavenly Judgment, explaining that it is not a cause for fear, but a transparent process of justice. By understanding the ancient Sanctuary services and the prophecies of Daniel, we can gain confidence in God's timeline for human history.

videos.description: Episode 6 of this 13 part documentary series explores a critical challenge faced by Impact Hope when students express a deep-seated fear of returning to their lives in the refugee camps at the end of the school year. The episode details the urgent efforts by Impact Hope to address these fears and find a sustainable solution to ensure the safety and continued education of the students.

videos.description: How can we tell whether someone who claims the gift of prophecy is truly speaking for God? This lesson explores the biblical tests of a genuine prophet, beginning with the counsel of 1 John 4:1 to “test the spirits.” Like a diamond examined for authenticity, prophetic claims must be carefully tested by Scripture. Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.

Discover Bible-based answers to grow your faith and deepen your walk
